agent_runs_select_own_organization.name: agent_runs_select_own_organization
agent_runs_select_own_organization.using: "agent_runs"."organization_id" = (select public.current_organization_id()) and "agent_runs"."triggered_by_type" = 'user' and "agent_runs"."triggered_by_id" = (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()))

agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization.name: agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization
agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization.using: "agent_tool_calls"."organization_id" = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where id = "agent_tool_calls"."agent_run_id")

job_reports_select_job.name: job_reports_select_job
job_reports_select_job.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.jobs where id = job_reports.job_id and organization_id = job_reports.organization_id) and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role <> 'ACCOUNTANT')

jobs_select_own.name: jobs_select_own
jobs_select_own.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and (role <> 'TECHNICIAN' or id = jobs.assigned_user_id))

jobs_amounts_check.name: jobs_amounts_check
jobs_amounts_check.value: "jobs"."price" >= 0 and "jobs"."estimated_cost" >= 0 and ("jobs"."actual_cost" is null or "jobs"."actual_cost" >= 0) and "jobs"."estimated_margin" = "jobs"."price" - "jobs"."estimated_cost"

jobs_schedule_check.name: jobs_schedule_check
jobs_schedule_check.value: ("jobs"."scheduled_start" is null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" is null) or ("jobs"."scheduled_start" is not null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" is not null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" > "jobs"."scheduled_start")

quote_items_select_quote.name: quote_items_select_quote
quote_items_select_quote.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.quotes where id = quote_items.quote_id and organization_id = quote_items.organization_id)

quote_items_values_check.name: quote_items_values_check
quote_items_values_check.value: "quote_items"."quantity" > 0 and "quote_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "quote_items"."cost_estimate" >= 0 and "quote_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "quote_items"."sort_order" >= 0

quotes_select_own.name: quotes_select_own
quotes_select_own.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role <> 'TECHNICIAN')
